name: gridzone
description: GridZone - Bomberman battle royale with instant on-chain USDC settlement on Monad

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

//deps: The server's runtime dependencies are duplicated here on purpose. PaaS platforms (Railway, Render) run a single `npm install` at the repo root and then `npm start`, without reliably running a nested install for server/. Node's ESM resolver walks up from server/src/index.js and finds these in the root node_modules/, so the server starts regardless of whether the platform honoured a nested install or a custom build command. Keep these versions in sync with server/package.json.
